//source2: Anthropic Usage & Cost Admin API and needs one of the keys below.
//extraCards: true adds the spend/token/model/project cards after the two
//extraCards2: rate-limit gauges. CUBE_EXTRA_CARDS=1 / =0 overrides this either way.
//host: Address to listen on (or set CUBE_HOST). Empty = every interface, which a
//host2: cube polling over WiFi needs. 127.0.0.1 keeps the bridge off the LAN; the
//host3: Mac helper still reaches it there, since it always uses 127.0.0.1.
//gmail: Adds a MAIL card with your unread count, read over IMAP. Needs 2-step
//gmail3: Or set CUBE_GMAIL_USER / CUBE_GMAIL_PASSWORD. Leave empty for no card.
